title: Garden party psychology - boundaries and conversations you might have as an aspiring psychologist!

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，从那以后，我也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励以及我提供的独家支持礼包，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆与梅森的精美礼品，以及限时的一对一教练指导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止时间为11月16日星期一晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Beth and I'm a psychological well-being practitioner from Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫贝丝，是一名来自纽卡斯尔的心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say the biggest thank you to the contributors of the Clinical Psychologist
sentences.zh: 我只想向《临床心理学家》

sentences.en: Collective book.
sentences.zh: 集锦一书的撰稿人们表示最诚挚的感谢。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed reading this so much and loved having an insight into the range of backgrounds and experiences people have prior to applying for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢阅读这本书，并很高兴能深入了解人们在申请博士学位之前所拥有的各种背景和经历。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting seeing the potential barriers to the application as well and how I can try and work around this.
sentences.zh: 看到申请中潜在的障碍以及我如何尝试克服这些障碍，也非常有趣。

sentences.en: I really started to doubt myself and whether I was good enough to apply for the Clinical Psychology
sentences.zh: 我曾开始怀疑自己，怀疑自己是否有资格申请临床心理学

sentences.en: Doctorate.
sentences.zh: 博士学位。

sentences.en: But this has really given me the confidence boost that I needed to give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 但这确实给了我尝试所需的信心。

sentences.en: So, the biggest thank you ever.
sentences.zh: 所以，向你们致以最衷心的感谢。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am absolutely making hay whilst the sun shines.
sentences.zh: 我真的是在趁热打铁。

sentences.en: I am recording this in the school summer holidays and my children have just gone to the park with Daddy.
sentences.zh: 我是在学校暑假期间录制这一期的，我的孩子们刚和爸爸去公园了。

sentences.en: I've got to go to the dentist shortly and I was like, I've got some time.
sentences.zh: 我一会儿得去牙医诊所，当时我想，我还有点时间。

sentences.en: I can record this podcast episode that's been floating around in my head for a few days now.
sentences.zh: 我可以录制这期在脑海里盘旋了好几天的播客节目了。

sentences.en: So, here I am.
sentences.zh: 所以，我来了。

sentences.en: Where are you?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里？

sentences.en: I hope you are living your best life right now.
sentences.zh: 我希望你现在正过着最美好的生活。

sentences.en: And if not, that you've got plans to unwind and de-stress and make yourself feel a whole lot better.
sentences.zh: 如果没有，也希望你已经有了放松、减压和让自己感觉好得多的计划。

sentences.en: Some things that make us feel better and sometimes things that make us feel worse are socialising and getting out and about.
sentences.zh: 有些事情能让我们感觉更好，有时有些事情则会让我们感觉更糟，比如社交以及外出走动。

sentences.en: You will know whether that is a good thing for you.
sentences.zh: 你会知道这究竟对你有没有好处。

sentences.en: You will know whether that makes you feel a bit uncomfortable and not entirely like you are thriving.
sentences.zh: 你会知道这是否会让你感到有点不舒服，并不完全像是你在蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: We are all different and what the pandemic showed us is that sometimes stepping back from social
sentences.zh: 我们各不相同，大流行向我们表明，有时从社交

sentences.en: pressures can be a good thing, but other times it makes us feel like we're not really connecting to people when we're not meeting people and getting out and about.
sentences.zh: 压力中抽身出来可能是一件好事，但有时不与人见面、不外出走动会让我们觉得自己与他人失去了真正的联系。

sentences.en: For some people, Zoom just doesn't cut it.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，Zoom根本不管用。

sentences.en: And like I said, you will know where you're at on that.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，你很清楚自己目前处于什么状态。

sentences.en: I am very much looking forward to this coming Friday when I'm going to be meeting up with
sentences.zh: 我非常期待即将到来的星期五，因为我要去见

sentences.en: one of my very loveliest friends who I actually trained with and then life and children have somewhat got in our way and also the pandemic, of course, of face-to-face antics.
sentences.zh: 我最可爱的朋友之一，我们曾一起接受培训，但后来生活和孩子在某种程度上阻碍了我们，当然还有大流行的影响，导致我们无法进行面对面的互动。

sentences.en: But we're going out for dinner this coming weekend and I cannot wait.
sentences.zh: 但这个周末我们要出去吃晚餐，我简直等不及了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I'm totally going to pick you up to maximise all of our gossip potential.
sentences.zh: 而且我想，我绝对要把你接上，以最大限度地发挥我们八卦的潜力。

sentences.en: So yeah, don't underestimate the value of having things to look forward to and having things to be excited about.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，不要低估有所期待和对事物感到兴奋的价值。

sentences.en: My sister-in-law uses her fridge as a method of helping her feel really excited about life.
sentences.zh: 我嫂子用她的冰箱来帮助她对生活感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: She likes to have like a little list of things she's got booked up.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢列一张小清单，记下她已经预订好的事情。

sentences.en: And once that list starts looking a little bit light, what she does is she makes sure she's
sentences.zh: 一旦那张清单看起来有点空，她就会确保

sentences.en: booking things so that she can be really mindfully excited about them in advance every time she opens or closes the fridge.
sentences.zh: 预订一些活动，这样每次她打开或关闭冰箱时，都能提前对它们进行真正的正念兴奋。

sentences.en: So yeah, that might be a little technique that you find useful.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这或许是一个你觉得有用的小技巧。

sentences.en: It's a bit like having a dream board, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这有点像拥有一个梦想板，对吧？

sentences.en: But it's on your fridge and it's stuff that's actually going to happen.
sentences.zh: 但它在你的冰箱上，而且是真正会发生的事情。

sentences.en: You could put things that you dream about as well.
sentences.zh: 你也可以把你的梦想写在上面。

sentences.en: You could well put your goals for psychology on there as well so that you see it day in, day out and it becomes part of your daily fabric.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以把你的心理学目标也写在上面，这样你日复一日地看到它，它就会成为你日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: But anyway, this is my roundabout waffle for helping us get on track with thinking about being social and being a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，这是我拐弯抹角的一番废话，目的是帮我们步入正轨，思考社交和作为一名心理学家的意义。

sentences.en: How does that work for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说效果如何？

sentences.en: Do you tell people what you do for work?
sentences.zh: 你会告诉别人你的工作是什么吗？

sentences.en: Do you tell people if you're working in mental health or if you're working in education or
sentences.zh: 如果你在心理健康领域工作，或者如果你在教育领域工作，或者

sentences.en: if you're working in forensic services, how does it make you feel when you do share stuff?
sentences.zh: 如果你在法医服务部门工作，你会告诉别人吗？当你分享这些事情时，你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Does it make you feel exposed or does it make you feel good?
sentences.zh: 这会让你感到暴露还是会让你感觉很好？

sentences.en: Do you like being the garden party psychologist?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢当花园派对里的心理学家吗？

sentences.en: Do you like having people ask your opinion and helping them feel differently or better about things?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢别人征求你的意见并帮助他们对事情有不同的看法或感觉更好吗？

sentences.en: Or are you finding that when you mention what your job is that you are welcoming in, you know, complicated questions that you'd rather not have?
sentences.zh: 还是你发现，当你提及自己的工作时，你是在自找麻烦，你知道的，迎来了你宁愿避开的复杂问题？

sentences.en: Or maybe you are finding that your viewpoint is very different to the viewpoint of people that you're socialising with.
sentences.zh: 或者也许你发现你的观点与你社交的人的观点非常不同。

sentences.en: Maybe in your culture or around your friendships, there's not much of an understanding around mental health.
sentences.zh: 也许在你的文化中或你的朋友圈里，对心理健康的理解并不多。

sentences.en: Maybe there's a pull up your socks kind of mentality and get on with it.
sentences.zh: 也许有一种咬紧牙关、挺过去的硬汉心态。

sentences.en: Or maybe there's just a lot of stigma, shame, kind of guilt inducing stuff around people who do need your service.
sentences.zh: 或者也许围绕着那些真正需要你服务的人，存在着大量的耻辱、羞耻和内疚感。

sentences.en: Or maybe people are even shaming you, thinking you ought to be the service user and not the person offering the services.
sentences.zh: 或者也许人们甚至在羞辱你，认为你应该成为服务的使用者，而不是提供服务的人。

sentences.en: Maybe other people find it hard to take you seriously as an actual grown-up offering useful stuff.
sentences.zh: 也许其他人很难把你当成一个能提供有用东西的真正成年人来看待。

sentences.en: Maybe you find it difficult to take yourself seriously in that regard as well.
sentences.zh: 也许你发现在这方面也很难认真对待自己。

sentences.en: You know, I'm acutely aware of when I was an assistant psychologist and I didn't feel like
sentences.zh: 你知道，我深深地意识到，当我还是个助理心理学家时，我觉得

sentences.en: my, on paper, my life was looking as professional as I wanted it to personally, given the level of responsibility that I had in my job, you know.
sentences.zh: 从纸面上看，考虑到我在工作中承担的责任水平，我的生活并没有达到我个人想要的那么专业，你知道的。

sentences.en: So the things that myself and my friends got up to at the weekends, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和我的朋友们周末都在做些什么，你知道的。

sentences.en: So Laura, I'm thinking about that trip to the Bradlaugh, fun times, but definitely stuff that's of then as an era, not now, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以劳拉，我想到了那次去布拉德洛的旅行，那是一段欢乐的时光，但绝对是那个时代的产物，而不是现在，你知道的。

sentences.en: So I absolutely treat all of those escapades as being really important and really fun and part of what has led me to be this qualified psychologist before you.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对把所有这些经历都视为非常重要、非常有趣，也是促使我成为你面前这位合格心理学家的部分原因。

sentences.en: But there was that sense of a bit of a life mismatch, really, that I was doing really proper and important stuff.
sentences.zh: 但确实有一种生活错位感，即我正在做非常正经和重要的事情。

sentences.en: And that was the case during training as well.
sentences.zh: 在培训期间也是如此。

sentences.en: So when I first moved for training, I was just renting a room from one of my brother's friends.
sentences.zh: 所以当我刚搬过去参加培训时，我只是租了我哥哥的一个朋友的一个房间。

sentences.en: And it just didn't feel like I was a proper enough grown-up.
sentences.zh: 感觉自己还不够像个成熟的大人。

sentences.en: Actually, when I moved out the next year and got my own place, it felt much more holistic as a grown-up experience, if that even makes sense.
sentences.zh: 事实上，第二年我搬出去有了自己的住处后，作为成年人的体验要全面得多，如果这还算说得通的话。

sentences.en: I felt like I needed to have all of my ducks in a row.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我需要把所有事情都安排得井井有条。

sentences.en: And one of my clients never heard that expression before.
sentences.zh: 我的一个客户以前从未听过这个表达。

sentences.en: And so I had to explain what ducks in a row are.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不解释什么是“把鸭子排成一排”。

sentences.en: So in case you don't know, and it might not be a super common phrase where you come from,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你不知道的话——在你来自的地方，无论你住在哪个国家的哪个地方，甚至无论你源自世界的哪个地方，这可能都不是一个超级常见的短语。

sentences.en: whichever part of the country you live in, or maybe even which part of the world you originate from.
sentences.zh: “把鸭子排成一排”的意思是把你的事情都安排好，你知道的，并且进展得相当顺利。

sentences.en: Ducks in a row means kind of all of your stuff lined up, you know, and doing reasonably well.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是职业上的。

sentences.en: So it might be occupational.
sentences.zh: 这可能是教育方面的。

sentences.en: It might be educational.
sentences.zh: 这可能是人际关系方面的。

sentences.en: It might be relationship.
sentences.zh: 这可能是你的生活环境。

sentences.en: It might be your living environment.
sentences.zh: 这可能是你的原生家庭。

sentences.en: It might be your birth family.
sentences.zh: 所有这些“鸭子”都乖乖听话，而不是像无头苍蝇一样朝随机方向乱晃。

sentences.en: All of those ducks are behaving themselves and not like meandering off in random directions.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所说的“把鸭子排成一排”。

sentences.en: So that's what I mean by ducks in a row.
sentences.zh: 这可能对你有共鸣，也可能没有。

sentences.en: And that may or may not resonate with you too.
sentences.zh: 但这有点题外话了。

sentences.en: But this is a little bit of an aside.
sentences.zh: 这不是一期关于“把鸭子排成一排”的播客节目。

sentences.en: This was not a podcast episode about ducks in a row.
sentences.zh: 也许那是改天再聊的话题。

sentences.en: Maybe that is a conversation for another day.
sentences.zh: 这期节目讨论的是，当你与他人谈论你的工作时，你的感受如何，无论是选择说，还是选择不说。

sentences.en: This was about how you feel when you talk to people about what you do, whether you choose to, whether you don't choose to.
sentences.zh: 好了，这期节目的灵感来源于最近关于SSRI药物与抑郁症的新闻。

sentences.en: Okay, so this episode is inspired by the recent news about SSRI medication and depression.
sentences.zh: 我的许多听众发现，那些一直在服药的人随后会向他们的朋友倾诉，即

sentences.en: And what a number of my audience have found is that people who have been taking the medication and then reaching out to their friends, i.e.
sentences.zh: 也许你，作为他们认识的最高级的心理健康专业人士。

sentences.en: maybe you, as the most senior kind of mental health professional that they know.
sentences.zh: 这关乎这对你自身的影响，以及你在该角色中所承载的责任分量。

sentences.en: And it's about the impact of that on yourself and the weight of responsibility that you carry as well in the role.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也与我之前和塔拉博士一起制作的那期节目有关，

sentences.en: And of course, this is also linked to the previous episode that I did with Dr. Tara,
sentences.zh: 我们在那期节目中讨论了自称为心理学家究竟意味着什么，谁应该或可以使用这个头衔，

sentences.en: where we were discussing what it even means to call yourself a psychologist and who should or could be using this title
sentences.zh: 以及它是否必然意味着接受过专业培训的资格。

sentences.en: and whether it necessarily infers a professional trained qualification.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们知道人们，尤其是那些在友情或亲情中信任你的人，很可能会在这个类问题上征求你的意见，真的。

sentences.en: So, you know, what we know is that people, especially people that trust you in your friendship role or in your family, might well seek your opinion on this kind of issue, really.
sentences.zh: 你知道，鉴于新闻中的报道，人们想知道他们是否应该继续服药。

sentences.en: You know, people are wondering whether they should continue to take their medication, given what's been in the news.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难。

sentences.en: And it's really difficult.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能提前给我们透个风声说这个消息要公布就好了，因为这显然会让患者、朋友和家人陷入混乱，

sentences.en: You know, it would be good if they'd given us a bit of a heads up that this was coming out, because this obviously sends patients, friends, family into turmoil
sentences.zh: 并且也会引发各种复杂的情绪，比如：我是不是被误导了？

sentences.en: and also can bring up all sorts of complicated feelings around, have I been misled?
sentences.zh: 难道只有我这样吗？

sentences.en: Is it just me then?
sentences.zh: 所以如果我的大脑没有化学失衡，我是不是坏掉了？

sentences.en: So if it's not a chemical imbalance in my brain, am I broken?
sentences.zh: 问题出在我身上吗？

sentences.en: Am I the problem?
sentences.zh: 我是不是应该感到责任、内疚和羞耻？

sentences.en: Should I be feeling responsible, you know, guilt, shame?
sentences.zh: 我想，如果有人向你抛出这类对话，把人们重新指引给他们的全科医生或任何开具该药物处方的人，总是非常有用做法。

sentences.en: And I think if you're being asked these types of conversations, it's always really useful to direct people back to their GP or whoever is prescribing that medication.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是由成人心理健康团队开具的，或者是为儿童和青少年心理健康团队开具的处方，

sentences.en: So it might be that it's being prescribed by an adult mental health team or for that matter, a children's and adolescent's mental health team,
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，将这些问题重新引回给那些医疗保健提供者尤为重要。

sentences.en: in which case these questions are especially important to be directed back towards those health care providers.
sentences.zh: 建议说，事实上，由于我们没有预见到这项研究会公开发表，你所了解的并不一定比新闻报道的更多，这可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: It may be helpful to kind of suggest that actually, because we didn't see this coming as research being published, that you don't necessarily know any more than is in the press.
sentences.zh: 你对药物的看法、对诊断的看法以及，你知道的，对表现出来的问题的看法，

sentences.en: And your take on medication and your take on diagnosis and, you know, presenting problems
sentences.zh: 将基于许多定制的事实，你知道的，围绕患者和个人的心理构式。

sentences.en: is going to be based on a number of bespoke facts, you know, formulations around the patient and around the person.
sentences.zh: 而且由于你没有掌握所有这些病史，

sentences.en: And because you don't have privy to all of that history,
sentences.zh: 由你来做那个向他们提供建议的人其实并不合适。

sentences.en: it's not really appropriate for you to be the person to advise them.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以探讨各种选择，但你也可以选择不这样做。

sentences.en: So you can talk through options, but you may not choose to.
sentences.zh: 你的生活中可能不想要这些。

sentences.en: You might not want that in your life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能只想做你朋友的朋友。

sentences.en: You know, you might just want to be your friend's friend.
sentences.zh: 你可能不想做朋友倾诉心理健康问题的倾听对象。

sentences.en: You might not want to be your friend's sounding board for mental health.
sentences.zh: 这必须是可以接受的。

sentences.en: And that has to be OK.
sentences.zh: 否则，可能会发生的情况是，你不仅要处理工作环境中所有人的病例，还要处理朋友、家人

sentences.en: Otherwise, what might happen is that you're holding a caseload of everybody in your work environment, but you're also holding a separate caseload of your friends and family
sentences.zh: 以及你在路上遇到的随机路人的独立病例。

sentences.en: and random people that you meet along the way.
sentences.zh: 当然，对于这些影响深远的关系，你不会获得督导，如果他们根据我们讨论过的内容采纳了建议，你也不会获得保险，你知道的。

sentences.en: And of course, you wouldn't be supervised for those impactful relationships and nor would you be insured, you know, if they took advice based on what we've discussed.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为绝对重要的是要认识到你可以拒绝。

sentences.en: So I think it's absolutely important to recognise that you can say no.
sentences.zh: 如果你拒绝置评，或者暗示自己并不是最适合置评的人，你并不是在残忍对待他们。

sentences.en: You aren't being cruel if you, you know, do refuse to comment or suggest that you're not the most appropriate person to comment.
sentences.zh: 这绝对没问题。

sentences.en: That's absolutely OK.
sentences.zh: 能够与一个公正的人一起把事情理清楚是一件好事。

sentences.en: And it is good to be able to talk through things with someone that's impartial.
sentences.zh: 对于你的朋友或家庭成员，甚至对于同事，你都不可能是公正的，因为你与这些人有着，你知道的，过往交集，

sentences.en: You will not be impartial for a member of your friends or family group, even for a colleague, because you will have, you know, history with those people
sentences.zh: 而且无论结果如何，你都会投入情感。

sentences.en: and you'll be invested in whatever the outcome is.
sentences.zh: 而治疗师或全科医生则要抽离得多，如果运气好的话，能够仅仅作为倾听者陪伴在当事人身边。

sentences.en: Whereas, you know, a therapist or a GP is that much more removed and able to be just, just there for the person to hear them with any luck.
sentences.zh: 所以绝对不是暗示你做不到，而是关乎你是否应该这样做，以及这样做对你和来访者是否仁慈。

sentences.en: So absolutely not suggesting that you couldn't do it, but it's whether, whether you should be doing it and whether it's kind to you and to the client to do that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可以向他们承认，你看出这给他们带来了一些痛苦，而且在这样的时刻寻求支持和建议是没有问题的，

sentences.en: You know, you could recognise with them that you can see that this is causing them some distress and that it's OK to reach out for support and advice in times like this
sentences.zh: 如果他们这么做，并不说明他们有什么不好，而且你会鼓励他们这么做。

sentences.en: and that it doesn't say anything bad about them if they do and that you would encourage them to do that.
sentences.zh: 能够进行这种公开、诚实的沟通真的很重要。

sentences.en: It's really important to be able to have these open, honest communications.
sentences.zh: 所以在你获得资格认证之前这可能会很困难，因为，你知道的，你可能会觉得你拥有专业的意见，但关键在于与他人分享这些意见是否合适。

sentences.en: So it can be difficult before you're qualified because, you know, you might feel that you have a professional opinion, but it's whether it's appropriate to share that with people.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我绝对经历过在派对上喝了几杯酒后别人问我问题的情况。

sentences.en: And, you know, I have absolutely been at parties when I've had a couple of glasses of wine and people ask me a question.
sentences.zh: 然后不知不觉中，感觉就像坐在特伦特博士的治疗长椅上一样。

sentences.en: And then before you know it, it's like being on the therapy couch with Dr. Trent.
sentences.zh: 这其实不太合适，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's not that appropriate, is it really?
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，曾有人对我说：“哇，我真的很珍视我们之间的那次交谈。”

sentences.en: But that said, people have said to me, you know, wow, I really valued that chat we had.
sentences.zh: 这和我从别处任何人那里得到的真的不一样。

sentences.en: It's really different than what I've got from anyone anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 这并不总是关于治疗。

sentences.en: And it's not always about therapy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有时人们只是看重我对世界的立场和我对事情的看法。

sentences.en: You know, people sometimes just value my stance on the world and my stance on things.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这只是在思考什么是合适的，什么是专业的，什么也是在你的，你知道的，当前资格认证范围之内的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's just thinking about what is appropriate, what is professional, what is within your, you know, current qualification realms as well.
sentences.zh: 我们可不想成为彻头彻尾的叛逆者，到处胡乱提出建议，对象甚至可能根本没有寻求建议，你知道的。

sentences.en: We don't want to be totally renegade, punting out advice, left, right and centre, possibly for people who haven't even asked for it, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我和来访者合作并观察耐受之窗时，

sentences.en: So when I'm working with clients and we're looking at the window of tolerance,
sentences.zh: 他们会注意到自己什么时候开始好转，因为他们开始注意到世界是多么缺乏调节，并发现自己想要安抚和调节这个世界。

sentences.en: they notice when they start to get better because they start to notice how unregulated the world is and they find themselves wanting to soothe and regulate the world.
sentences.zh: 当我和来访者合作并观察耐受之窗时，他们会注意到自己什么时候开始好转，因为他们开始注意到世界是多么缺乏调节，并发现自己想要安抚和调节这个世界。

sentences.en: But it wouldn't be appropriate to walk up to a stranger and go,
sentences.zh: 但要是直接走到一个陌生人面前说，

sentences.en: I'm really noticing that you're outside of your window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 我真的注意到你现在情绪崩溃了。

sentences.en: I think you're using this, that and the other strategy because they haven't asked you for that help.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你正在使用这个、那个或别的策略，因为他们根本没有向你寻求这种帮助。

sentences.en: So sometimes the power is of being qualified and or experienced in mental health is that we can observe what might need to be done in future,
sentences.zh: 所以有时候，具备心理健康资质或经验的力量在于，我们可以观察到未来可能需要做的事情，

sentences.en: but it doesn't necessarily need to be us who says that or does it.
sentences.zh: 但这不一定非得由我们说出来或去做。

sentences.en: Okay, let's take a short break here and I will be back along on the other side.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们在这里稍作休息，我一会儿就回来。

sentences.en: The Clinical Psychologist Collective book is really insightful for anyone hoping to get onto the Clinical Doctorate.
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家合集》这本书对任何希望攻读临床博士学位的人都非常有启发。

sentences.en: I really love the individual accounts in this book and found them incredibly inspiring.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢书中个人的经历分享，觉得它们极具鼓舞性。

sentences.en: I've been very worried about my chances of getting onto the Clinical Psychology Doctorate as my path is far from traditional.
sentences.zh: 我一直很担心自己考取临床心理学博士的机会，因为我的道路一点也不传统。

sentences.en: So it was really reassuring hearing so many non-traditional routes others have taken.
sentences.zh: 所以听到其他人走过那么多非传统的道路，真的让我安心了很多。

sentences.en: Thank you for sharing these together and helping the next generation of students.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们分享这些经历，并帮助下一代学生。

sentences.en: So, yeah, people aren't necessarily going to know the difference between your job titles, you know, psychological well-being, practitioner,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，人们不一定会知道你们职位名称之间的区别，你知道的，心理健康从业者，

sentences.en: assistant psychologist, higher assistant psychologist, you know, mental health support worker, trainee clinical psychologist or trainee health or counselling psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 助理心理学家、高级助理心理学家，你知道的，心理健康支持工作者、见习临床心理学家或见习健康或咨询心理学家。

sentences.en: They're just going to hear, you know, the word psychological or mental health or psychologist and they know you've been to uni, you know, so you must know your stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们只会听到，你知道的，心理、心理健康或心理学家这些词，他们知道你上过大学，你知道的，所以你一定很专业。

sentences.en: But they don't know that you're not perhaps the most appropriate or the most experienced person that they could ask.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不知道你或许并不是他们可以求助的最合适或最有经验的人。

sentences.en: I would love your thoughts on all of this.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听大家对这一切的看法。

sentences.en: I'd love to know, you know, what you do when you're asked for your opinion or whether people do ask or whether, you know, you tell people that you just work in a supermarket
sentences.zh: 我很想知道，你知道的，当别人征求你的意见时你会怎么做，或者人们到底会不会问，或者你知道的，你是否会告诉别人你只是在超市工作

sentences.en: when you meet them with strangers.
sentences.zh: 当你遇到陌生人的时候。

sentences.en: You don't tell them what you do.
sentences.zh: 你不会告诉他们你是做什么的。

sentences.en: Maybe you don't want to bring that to your door.
sentences.zh: 也许你不想把工作带到日常生活中。

sentences.en: Let's have a conversation about this on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 让我们在Instagram上聊聊这个话题。

sentences.en: You can find me, Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你可以找到我，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent）。

sentences.en: And on the Facebook group, the Aspiring Psychologist Community.
sentences.zh: 还有在Facebook群组“有志心理学家社区”（The Aspiring Psychologist Community）里。

sentences.en: Come along and join us there and do join in the conversation around this so that we can really make sure we're thickening the narrative here.
sentences.zh: 快来加入我们吧，一定要参与围绕这个话题的讨论，这样我们才能真正确保在这里丰富我们的故事。

sentences.en: You might also find that people find you.
sentences.zh: 你可能也会发现人们会找到你。

sentences.en: They connect to you.
sentences.zh: 他们会与你建立联系。

sentences.en: They sense that you're a great listener.
sentences.zh: 他们感觉到你是一个很好的倾听者。

sentences.en: And before you know it, you're drowning in life stories that can feel quite heavy or unwelcomed.
sentences.zh: 不知不觉中，你被淹没在那些可能让人感觉相当沉重或不受欢迎的生活故事中。

sentences.en: You know, I only wanted to come to the party and drink mojitos.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我本来只是想来派对喝莫吉托的。

sentences.en: I didn't want to be therapizing.
sentences.zh: 我可不想当治疗师。

sentences.en: And that's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系，这很正常。

sentences.en: And you might find that because people see the psychologist in your title, maybe on LinkedIn or, you know, other areas where you might be networking professionally,
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现，因为人们在你的头衔里看到了心理学家，也许是在领英上，或者你知道的，你可能在进行专业社交的其他领域，

sentences.en: they might be saying, oh, could you just, you know, create this video for me on talking to people about X, Y or Z.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会说，哦，你能不能，你知道的，帮我做这个视频，讲讲和人们谈论A、B或C的事情。

sentences.en: Could you talk about this?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈这个吗？

sentences.en: Could you do that?
sentences.zh: 你能做那个吗？

sentences.en: And it's like, well, actually, I don't really feel that comfortable.
sentences.zh: 这就好比，嗯，实际上，我真的觉得不太舒服。

sentences.en: I don't feel it's that appropriate for me to be offering that and to just empower you to know that it's okay to say no and to direct to other areas, other areas of support,
sentences.zh: 我觉得由我来提供这些并赋予你权力去拒绝并引导至其他领域、其他支持领域，

sentences.en: other people that might be able to support.
sentences.zh: 其他能够提供支持的人，这并不太合适。

sentences.en: It's okay to say no.
sentences.zh: 拒绝是完全可以的。

sentences.en: You're not a meanie for being bounded in saying no.
sentences.zh: 设立界限并说不，并不代表你是个刻薄的人。

sentences.en: And again, this might be helpful for you to refresh your memory on what I believe is episode eight.
sentences.zh: 同样，这可能有助于你重温我相信是第八集的节目。

sentences.en: Yeah, I should never doubt myself.
sentences.zh: 对，我真不该怀疑自己。

sentences.en: It's episode eight.
sentences.zh: 这就是第八集。

sentences.en: I just checked episode eight is boundary setting for yourself and your clients.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚查过，第八集讲的是为你自己和你的客户设定界限。

sentences.en: And you might find that really useful, right?
sentences.zh: 你会发现这真的很有用，对吧？

sentences.en: Speaking of boundaries, my friends, it is time that I get out of my jogging bottoms and into my jeans to go and see the dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 说到界限，我的朋友们，我该脱下慢跑裤换上牛仔裤去看牙医了。

sentences.en: I hope you found this helpful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这些对你有帮助。

sentences.en: And I would really love your ideas around what you might do in these situations.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想听听大家对于在这些情况下你会怎么做的想法。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: What are your thoughts?
sentences.zh: 你有什么想法？

sentences.en: Do come and discuss this with me over on the Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 快来Facebook群组和我讨论这个话题吧。

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有玛丽安·特伦特博士陪伴的有志心理学家社区。

sentences.en: That is where lots of good stuff happens and it's totally free to join.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多好东西，而且完全免费加入。

sentences.en: So come and do that, won't you?
sentences.zh: 所以快来加入吧，好吗？

sentences.en: In the meantime, do come and connect in all the good places.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，欢迎在各大优质平台与我联系。

sentences.en: I am mostly Dr. Marianne Trent, but you can also find me as Good Thinking Psychological Services.
sentences.zh: 我通常是玛丽安·特伦特博士，但你也可以通过“美好思维心理服务”（Good Thinking Psychological Services）找到我。

sentences.en: Thank you for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Sorry, this is a brief episode than usual, but you know, the dentist calls.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，这一集比平时短，但你知道的，牙医在召唤。

sentences.en: Take care of you and stay kind.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己，保持善良。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，

sentences.en: then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 那就让这成为你的指南。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to being qualified.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客伴你左右，你离获得资质就不远了。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这就是由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的有志心理学家播客。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Max.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是马克斯。

sentences.en: I work as an assistant psychologist in the Learning Disability Service in West Yorkshire.
sentences.zh: 我在西约克郡的学习障碍服务部门担任助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Like most people working in psychology,
sentences.zh: 就像大多数从事心理学工作的人一样，

sentences.en: I'm slowly but surely working myself up to that seemingly impossible goal of getting onto the clinical doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我正一步一个脚印地朝着考取临床博士学位这个看似不可能的目标努力。

sentences.en: With that angle in mind, I thought I'd have a look at what's out there and see what books might be helpful for this.
sentences.zh: 带着这个目标，我想看看市面上都有什么书，看看哪些书会有所帮助。

sentences.en: I came across Marianne's book,
sentences.zh: 我偶然看到了玛丽安的书，

sentences.en: The Clinical Psychologist Collective, and decided that this would be a great buy for me to help me on the journey.
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家合集》，并决定买下这本书来帮助我的这段旅程。

sentences.en: I found Marianne's book really informative, most insightful.
sentences.zh: 我发现玛丽安的书信息量极大，非常有启发性。

sentences.en: I especially liked how the stories reassured me that you don't need to be academically perfect to become a psychologist, and that as long as you have good interpersonal skills,
sentences.zh: 我尤其喜欢书中的故事让我确信，要成为一名心理学家，你并不需要学术上十全十美，只要你具备良好的人际交往能力，

sentences.en: such as compassion and empathy, you will get there.
sentences.zh: 比如同情心和同理心，你就一定能成功。

sentences.en: I would highly recommend this book to all aspiring psychologists, and also those who want to know a bit more about the world of clinical psychology
sentences.zh: 我强烈向所有有志成为心理学家的人推荐这本书，同时也推荐给那些想对临床心理学世界有更多了解，

sentences.en: and maybe want to work in that field one day.
sentences.zh: 并且也许有一天想在该领域工作的人。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能通过超越出卖时间来赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，我自2019年以来一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的一对多项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我个人的独家支持套餐，不收取任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组成员头脑风暴、大师班、个性化指导、福特姆和梅森（Fortnum & Mason）礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
